mathematics.assertion_tested: For exactly ten declared central chemical-potential states and two integration tolerances, the original carrier tree-level TF EOS yields finite-surface TOV solutions with finite charge, positive central sound speed, ADM mass below mQ, and compactness below the proven enthalpy bounds, with R/M/Q refinement changes below 2e-7.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: real floating arithmetic, Python float64/scipy RK45
mathematics.conventions: Natural units m=G=lambda_total=1 are dimensionless EOS scaling, not a claim of semiclassical validity at Planck mass. q is conserved charge density; mass is ADM/TOV mass. x=(omega_local^2-m^2)/(m^2 zeta).
non_claims: No radial, angular or nonlinear stability theorem
No exhaustive scan or observed compact object
No universal result beyond the declared TF EOS branch
